name: Lists
description: Lists of anything: shopping, recipes, packing, ideas, projects. Entries with sub-entries and free fields; entries with a date show up in the calendar.
instructions: Lists hold anything the user keeps: shopping, recipes, packing, ideas, projects. Use the structure: sections are entries with children (never header lines like 'Ingredients:'), and details go into fields instead of the text (qty, store, url, …), e.g. {"text": "Ingredients", "children": [{"text": "Minced beef", "fields": {"qty": "500 g"}}]}. A date in fields.when (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, optional fields.end) puts the entry on the calendar. Look at the existing lists before creating a new one (reuse e.g. the shopping list), and ask before deleting a whole list.

in_calendar.title: Show dated entries in the calendar
in_calendar.help: Entries with a 'when' field appear in AAC's calendar (and its agenda).
